Episode 134. Duel on the Ship (2)
Mary, Mary, Mary!
The already heated atmosphere now literally turned into a cauldron of frenzy.
The residents transformed into spectators in the arena, and witnessing such a fight so close was undoubtedly a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.
'Ah, this is it. This is the feeling I've been missing...!'
The Pirate King and the King of Strategy, Cosmos, was truly experiencing the thrill and ecstasy coursing through his body after a long time.
After helping Jin in the Compass Theft operation three years ago, Cosmos hadn't been able to host a single tournament. He had always wandered the dark spaces of the sea as a wanted man.
'Come to think of it, Jin Gray and Paul Mick's match was the best of my tournament life. Starting today, I hope to run a proper martial arts tournament with the support of Run Kandel!'
Instead of Mary's provocation of drawing her thumb across her neck, Jin was aware of Cosmos looking up at him with teary and shining eyes.
'What is this? His face is so full of emotion that it's overwhelming.'
Cosmos naturally wiped the corner of his eye and opened his mouth again.
"Zuaaaaaah! Mary, the Stormy Mary! Now, her! Opponent is-!"
As if they had made a prior agreement, the crowd quieted down as Cosmos introduced Jin.
And amazingly, the connected decks emitted twinkling lights, and the subordinates who seemed to be officers moved between the masts and fired something like a cannon toward Jin.
Bang! Bang!
The cannon fired thick ropes. At the end was a hook, and dozens of ropes tied with thick cloth and silk formed a bridge connecting Tikan and the ship.
This time, not only the audience, but Jin and his colleagues, and even Mary couldn't help but admire Cosmos's incredible direction.
'I've always felt this way, but it's strange why someone with such ability was involved in piracy.'
Jin looked down at the rope path connected to the deck.

"He was the shock reserve rider, the murderer of the Great Wizard Kidad Hole, the legendary brain swordsman Barmel! The contractor of Soldelet and Black Dragon Murakan! The savior of the Holy Kingdom of Vankela and the Magic Swordsman Run Kandel, who could perhaps become the next ruler of Run Kandel, the youngest, the 12th generation rider... and the winner of the 1796 Cosmos Tournament!"
He wanted to point out that something strange was mixed in, but it wasn't the atmosphere to do so.
Jin Run Kandel! Jin Run Kandel!
When one or two people shouted Jin's name from the railing, Cosmos put his index finger on his lips and shushed them.
Then he continued with a pause.

"...According to recent rumors floating around and stories from pub attendants, and various critics' associations, knight leagues, and warrior alliances' recent meetings. He is recently being called by this name."
Jin still didn't have a 'representative' alias.
Shadow Contractor, Magic Swordsman, Hero, etc. There were many adjectives, but there was no specific title that came to mind.
"...Let me introduce you! The dark and sharp black star, the monster of Run Kandel! Hufester's... Black, Sun, Child!"

Jin unknowingly coughed at that point, and Murakan took turns pointing at Jin and his companions, saying, "Heuktaeja, Heuktaeja! Hahaha, Heuktaejat!" and laughing like crazy. Fortunately, his laughter was drowned out by the following drumming sound.
In fact, no one had ever called Jin "Heuktaeja" until now.
That's partly because Jin wasn't actually a member of the royal or imperial family, but the main reason was because of Joshua's existence.
"Taeeja" is a word that refers to the next ruler.
With Joshua, the next family head, there weren't many people in Hupesuteo brave enough to give Jin that kind of nickname.
In that sense, Cosmos belonged to the very brave category, and he intuitively knew. The nickname Heuktaeja, which he first coined, would become a worldwide symbol for Jin in the future.
"Jiiiin- Runcaaan-deeel!"
As soon as the introduction ended, cheers two or three times louder than Mary's erupted, causing the sea in front of Tichan to reverberate.
Tichan was Jin's base, and Cosmos' introduction was so flashy that it was only natural for there to be a difference in reaction.
So when everyone was awestruck by the sight of his younger brother slowly descending the brilliant rope and silk path, Mary grabbed Cosmos' ear.
"You bastard, who are you hosting? Why is the introduction of the youngest one so much more extravagant than mine?"
"Ouch, ouch, my ear, my ear, please! No, Captain! How can you blame me for that!?"
"What? You're crazy…"
"Actually, that silk path was originally prepared for you, Captain. But you just jumped down before we could shoot it, so we had no choice but to use it for your younger brother."
"Hmm."
"And are you really that upset about your younger brother doing well? On the way here, you've been bragging about him nonstop!"
"Of course, it's great that our youngest is doing well, but it feels strange."
"Hehe, don't worry. If you win, I, Cosmos, will set off an even grander celebration for you. I wish you good luck, Captain!"
Eventually, Jin walked down the silk path and onto the deck.
The enthusiastic cheers continued, but as Jin and Mary stared at each other, the atmosphere became increasingly tense.
The audience swallowed their dry saliva, enjoying the tension, and the siblings were silent for a while.
"By the way, Yona, did that tiny guy leave? Hey, Miumul!"
"Yes, Murakan."
"Who do you think will win? Let's bet, a thousand gold coins."
"Isn't a thousand gold coins a bit too much for a bet?"
"Two thousand. I remembered I have something to live for."
"I would have chosen Jin if there were no rules. But in this situation… I don't know. One thing is for sure, whoever wins, the impact will be tremendous. It's not just one or two eyes watching."

"There's hardly ever been a public fight between pure-blooded Runcandel of the current generation. This will clearly be a fight to demonstrate superiority to the public, and the losing side may lose more than expected."
As Alisa added an explanation, Balkas nodded in agreement.

"Especially Mary Run Candel has a lot to lose. She's from the 7th generation, but she's been treated almost like the top tier, and she's been highly regarded as the most interested swordsman since Baek Kyung."
It was a story that everyone knew if they were a proper warrior.
In fact, Shiron had shown considerable interest in Mary.
He even 'directly' passed on some of Run Candel's secret techniques.
"And the Swordmaster, you said you didn't know what kind of result the fight between the two would bring?"
"Yes, Sir Balkas."
"You must not have seen Mary Run Candel's sword firsthand. That's why you say that."
"Haven't you, Sir Balkas, never seen the young master's sword?"
"I would definitely bet on Mary Run Candel. If the master is not a magic swordsman but a pure swordsman, there is no need to hesitate. Absolutely."
"Alright, then you two bet on Mary. I'll bet on the kid."
As the bets were being placed, Mary, spinning her chain sword in the air, spoke first.

"Your lair is still under construction, isn't it, little one? It's no exaggeration to say that the entire Black King's Den is being moved to Tichan. But your trophies, weren't they protected by me and Brother Difus so that the flies wouldn't get tangled up?"
"I didn't know, sister."
"I wanted to fight the Black King's Den at least once, too. This kid, when did you grow up so much? To the point where you can destroy the Black King's Den alone."
Alone?
Just as he was about to object, Mary continued with a proud face.

"Until last year, Brother Difus and I saved you from the hardships of the Zipel magicians. In the Sword Garden, and in the Black King's Den, did you do that with the King's Sword and the Magic Sword? Actually, the goal I mentioned earlier is to far surpass you."
Although it seemed somewhat misunderstood, Mary didn't give Jin any chance to speak.
She was excitedly talking like a child who had just begun to unfold her big dream.
'I knew it from the beginning when she confronted me, she had such a determined look in her eyes, was it because of that misunderstanding?'
Mary clenched her fist.
"Little one."
"Yes, sister."
"Although we've decided to seal most of the big skills in this duel, I'll do my best. So don't you be sloppy either. If you don't do it right, I'll immediately bring down Tichan completely."
How can I fight half-heartedly against you, sister? It's impossible from the start.
Instead of answering like that, Jin decided to choose different words.
Since the fight had become inevitable, Jin wanted to use the method he was best at, as always.
Provoking and shaking the opponent to create an opening was one of the most important elements Jin considered in a fight.
"I understand, sister. But if you think so highly of me, before we start the fight... don't you have something to fix first?"
Mary's eyebrows twitched once.
"What is that?"
So far, the conversation between the two had been in low voices, close together, so the crowd couldn't hear it.
But the next moment, Jin shouted so that everyone around could hear clearly.
"Take off the blindfold!"
The loud shout echoed off the walls of Tichan.
"Um, sister."
Murakan once again scratched Mary's insides with laughter, and the crowd was just standing still, confused about whether it was okay to laugh or not.
"Now I'm starting to understand a bit why Jordan chopped off your arms back then..."
Roar-!
Literally in an instant, the shining aura of Mary's chain sword 'Venomous Snake' gathered.
It was an aura so dense that it was hard to believe it had formed so quickly.
'This is...!'
And Jin immediately recognized what she was trying to unleash with her first strike as soon as he saw her stance.
On the other hand, Mary was smiling and showing off her secret technique, which had been honed even more since last time.
Run Candel's 5th Secret Technique
Lightspeed Thrust
What Mary unleashed was the very sword she had used when she subdued Ozdok in the past.
'No way, this is crazy! We agreed to seal powerful techniques that could destroy a fleet and fight...!'
There was no time to question whether Run Candel's swordsman was so quick to break his word or lie.
Mary's Venomous Snake was already charging towards Jin.
